title: I built an MT5 Gold EA with prop-firm drawdown protection — looking for honest feedback
author: Due_Cauliflower1453
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I’m the developer of **Sycz HolyGrail**, an automated EA built specifically for **XAUUSD on MetaTrader 5**.

I want to be transparent from the beginning: **this is my own commercial EA**, currently listed on the MQL5 Market. I’m posting here because I’d like feedback from people who actually use EAs and automated systems rather than just posting another advertisement.

One of the main things I focused on during development was **risk management for prop-firm accounts**.

The EA includes:

* 9 internal Gold trading modules
* Adaptive position sizing
* Daily equity drawdown protection
* Overall account drawdown protection
* End-of-day trailing drawdown protection
* Configurable challenge profit target
* Automatic trading lock when protection limits are reached
* Pending-order removal and position management when a protection condition triggers
* News, spread, weekend and free-margin protections

For example, if a prop firm has a **5% daily-loss limit**, the EA can be configured to react earlier, such as around **4%**, instead of deliberately using the entire available drawdown.

The idea is to leave some margin for things like spread, commission, slippage and rapid XAUUSD movements.

I’m **not claiming that this guarantees passing a prop-firm challenge**. Prop-firm rules vary, execution conditions vary, and automated risk controls cannot eliminate trading risk.

The EA is also new, so I’m not going to pretend I have years of live results. At the moment I’m continuing backtesting, forward testing and gathering user feedback.

If anyone here runs automated Gold strategies or EAs on prop firms, I’d genuinely be interested in hearing what you think about the protection approach — especially daily drawdown versus trailing drawdown management.
